faults.en: Insufficient supply, foam, exposed suction and full waste disrupt washing

faults.zh: 停止供液并处置排废异常，恢复后检查完整循环

validation.zh: 覆盖液体、速度和工况变化后的基线

faults.en: Intentional air segments, viscosity changes or sampling delay can cause false decisions

faults.zh: 控制器判定任务有效性，传感器不单独证明剂量或方法结果

faults.en: Preserve the current specimen state before service and verify the recovered duty

validation.en: Cover concurrency, boundary states and complete recovery after faults

faults.en: Fatigue, wrong installation or excessive differential pressure can prevent closure

steps.en: Set supply for the actual liquid and backpressure and check prime and first flow

steps.zh: 记录输出、补液或复位时段及累计交付
steps.en: Record output, refill/reset periods and cumulative delivery

steps.zh: 测试换瓶、闲置与断电恢复
steps.en: Test bottle changes, idle and power-loss recovery

validation.zh: 测量工作流量趋势与累计体积，包含补液中断
validation.en: Measure flow trends and cumulative volume including refill interruptions

validation.zh: 按用途评价比例、过程或检测结果
validation.en: Evaluate ratio, process or detector results for the duty

faults.zh: 空源、气泡、滑移、压力变化或复位会扰动持续输出
faults.en: Empty supply, bubbles, slip, pressure change or reset can disturb output

faults.zh: 核对未完成量和过程状态后恢复，避免重复补给
faults.en: Confirm undelivered volume and process state before recovery without duplicate supply

input.zh: 取样点、目标分析、周期、滞留/弃样、保存与体积扰动
input.en: Sampling point, analyte, interval, hold-up/discard, preservation and volume disturbance

steps.zh: 预充并确认样本/系统液接触范围
steps.en: Prime and confirm sample/system-fluid contact surfaces

steps.zh: 确认液面与阀位，按工作量吸取并交付到目标位置
steps.en: Confirm liquid level and valve state, then aspirate and deliver the working aliquot

steps.zh: 清除共享段残液并记录下一样本前的恢复
steps.en: Clear shared-path residue and record recovery before the next sample

validation.zh: 在接收端测量实际交付，覆盖常用小量与最大任务量
validation.en: Measure delivery at the receiver at typical small doses and the largest task dose

validation.zh: 覆盖空闲后首剂、样本切换和高低浓度序列
validation.en: Cover first dose after idle, changeover and high-to-low sequences

faults.zh: 空吸、凝块/颗粒、针口贴壁或泄漏会改变实际交付
faults.en: Empty aspiration, clots/particles, wall sealing or leakage change delivery

faults.zh: 停止当前动作，确认样本身份并按方法决定重采或标记
faults.en: Stop the operation, confirm identity and decide re-sampling or flagging by method

input.zh: 液体或气液进口、酸性/温度、负压、排液量与气密要求
input.en: Flooded or mixed inlet, acidity/temperature, vacuum, drainage and leakage requirements

steps.zh: 区分供液与抽排支路，核查废液容器和排液通路
steps.en: Separate supply and aspiration; check the waste vessel and discharge route

steps.zh: 按清洗程序供液、接触并排空，监测溢流与吸空
steps.en: Supply, contact and empty by the wash program, watching overflow and exposed aspiration

steps.zh: 用空白或下一循环确认清洗后的恢复
steps.en: Check recovery with a blank or the next cycle

validation.zh: 在安装阻力下确认供液与峰值排废能力
validation.en: Verify supply and peak drainage at installed resistance

validation.zh: 测量残液、携带污染或方法规定的恢复结果
validation.en: Measure residue, carryover or method-defined recovery

faults.zh: 供液不足、泡沫、吸空和废液满会破坏清洗循环
faults.en: Insufficient supply, foam, exposed suction and full waste disrupt washing

faults.zh: 停止供液并处置排废异常，恢复后检查完整循环
faults.en: Stop supply, correct drainage faults and verify a complete recovered cycle

input.zh: 萃取步骤、相态、各步剂量/压力和产物去向
input.en: Extraction stage, phase, stage volumes/pressure and product destination

steps.zh: 核对试剂来源、材料和目标容器，预充排除异常气泡
steps.en: Check reagent source, materials and receiver; prime to remove unintended air

steps.zh: 按定义时序交付，记录实际液体接收与补液
steps.en: Deliver to the defined sequence and record receipt and refill

steps.zh: 切换或停机后完成清洗及首剂恢复
steps.en: Clean and recover the first dose after changeover or idle

validation.zh: 测目标物回收、相夹带、空白与残留
validation.en: Measure analyte recovery, phase carryover, blank and residue

faults.zh: 空源、气泡、喷嘴挂液及背压变化会影响首剂或末剂
faults.en: Empty source, bubbles, retained droplets and backpressure changes affect first or last doses

faults.zh: 中止受影响步骤，预充后验证恢复并避免重复加液
faults.en: Stop affected steps, verify recovery after prime and avoid duplicate dosing

input.zh: 计量/持续供液/清洗/抽排职责、实际介质与安装负载
input.en: Metering/continuous/wash/aspiration duties, actual liquid and installed load
